newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Sateras to buy timber firm.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Sateras to buy timber firm.

text.p: Malaysian property developer Sateras Resources (M) Bhd said on Thursday it had entered into an agreement to buy the entire share capital of Fijian-incorporated Valebasoga Tropikboards Ltd (VTL) for a total of about 126 million ringgit.
In a statement, Sateras said the purchase price was to be satisfied by the issue and allotment of 50.4 million new Sateras shares at 2.50 ringgit a share.

VTL is involved in making and supplying timber and wood products. Its mills and related buildings are located in Fiji and the company has a timber concession in Fiji in a total area of about 178,000 acres for 15 years from December 3, 1996.
In the statement, Sateras also said it was involved in a proposed acquisition of six hotels in Fiji for a total of 52.92 million ringgit.

It said the proposed purchase of the hotel properties will complement its involvement in the tourism industry. The VTL acquisition will help it diversify "into a new field of business", the statement added.
On completion of the proposed acquisitions, Sateras said its issued and paid-up share capital would increase from 192.36 million ringgit to 846.93 million ringgit.
